emits.description: Selects the survivor unit and computes valid move tiles
Gathers an adjacent resource, or moves the survivor to a valid tile
Builds the camp (campfire + tent) once wood/stone goals are met
Called when the match ends in victory or defeat
Resets the board after victory or defeat
